headline: A governed context foundation can support defined build and sustain work.
subtitle: Teams retain source links, approvals, and uncertainty as they reuse context for a bounded task.
foundation_note: Governed retrieval connects approved context to a defined work item.
build_use: Retrieve requirements, rules, dependencies, source references, acceptance criteria, and open questions for a bounded design, coding, test, migration, or cutover task.
build_measure: Track repeated discovery, review effort, traceability, and change readiness against a baseline.
sustain_use: Link incidents and requests to process intent, system behavior, prior decisions, dependencies, tests, and operational knowledge.
sustain_measure: Assess investigation time, knowledge retention, and maintenance effort with accountable teams.
status_pilot: FUTURE OR PILOT ITEM — PROOF REQUIRED
takeaway: Keep the context current, governed, source-linked, and available through controlled retrieval.
